title: US visa
tagline: B1/B2 tourist, visitor and business visas, F-1 student visas and J-1 exchange programs.
intro:
A US visa always involves an interview with a consular officer. The decision takes minutes, so your DS-160, your documents and the way you describe your trip must match in every detail.

We complete the form, help with additional forms (DS-5535, I-134 for a sponsor), book the interview and prepare you for the officer’s questions.
services: Paying the consular fee and booking the interview
Interview preparation: typical questions and answer review
Help with the **Green Card (DV Lottery)** entry during the registration period

sections.heading: Which visa do you need
sections.body:
- **B1/B2** — tourism, medical treatment, visiting relatives, business meetings and conferences.
- **F-1** — study at a US university, college or language school. Requires a Form I-20 from the school.
- **J-1** — exchange programs: Work & Travel, internships, academic exchange. Requires a Form DS-2019.

If your purpose is mixed, we will tell you which category fits — choosing the wrong visa is a common reason for refusal.

sections.heading: Why visas are refused and how to avoid it
sections.body:
The most common reason is that the officer is not convinced the applicant will return home (section 214(b)). Strong ties to Kyrgyzstan help — work, study, family, property, travel history — along with a consistent story at the interview.

We review weak points in advance and tell you honestly whether to apply now or strengthen your profile first.

documents: Passport valid at least 6 months beyond your stay
Digital photo meeting State Department requirements (5×5 cm)
Employment or study letter, bank statement
For F-1 / J-1: Form I-20 or DS-2019 and the SEVIS fee receipt
documents_note: The exact list depends on your purpose of travel — you get a personal checklist after the consultation.

steps.title: Consultation and visa choice
steps.text: We review your purpose and profile and assess risks.

steps.title: DS-160 form
steps.text: Completed in English and checked against your documents.

steps.title: Fee and appointment
steps.text: We pay the fee and choose an interview date.

steps.title: Interview preparation
steps.text: We rehearse the officer’s questions and the order of documents.

steps.title: Interview and passport
steps.text: Once approved, your passport with the visa is returned by courier or at a pickup point.

faq.q: How long is the wait for an interview?
faq.a: It depends on the embassy’s workload and changes during the year. We check current dates when booking.

A supplemental questionnaire the officer may request after the interview: travel history, addresses, employment and social media for recent years. We help you complete it quickly and consistently with your DS-160.

faq.q: Can I reapply after a refusal?
faq.a: Yes, there is no waiting period. But without changes to your application or circumstances, a new attempt often ends the same way. We start by analysing the reason for refusal.
